text.en:
Today you learn two new things.
You say that something is not true.
You ask a question.
I am not late.
It means: I did not come after the time.
Are you ready?
It means: I want to know if you can start.

title.en: Add not, or swap the order

text.en:
To say no, put not after the small word.
The door is not open.
To ask, put the small word first.
The door is open. Is the door open?
She is ready. Is she ready?
The small words stay the same: am, is, are.

You will make sentences with not.
You will make questions.
You will also answer them.
Yes, she is. No, she is not.
Look at the question first.
Answer with the same small word: am, is or are.
